description: ADR-0009 / P2: the single source of secret-CONTENT regex patterns the external-AI pack sanitizer hard-fails on. Distinct from sensitive-key-patterns.json (which redacts structured data by field NAME): this list scans raw pack text for things that look like an actual live credential, regardless of what key they were under -- a pack that trips any of these must never be produced. Consumed by scripts/external-review/build-review-pack.py (P3) and, later, the product's Java in-app producer (P6) for the byte-identical-pack conformance requirement.
